description_en: Upgrades or downgrades the specifications of a storage-layer custom ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 升级或降级存储层私有定制RDS实例的规格
kebab_example: aliyun drds update-private-rds-class --drds-instance-id drds0000000000000 --db-instance-id rm-000000000000000 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePrivateRdsClass

parameters.help_en:
The specification code of the storage-layer custom ApsaraDB RDS instance after the update.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196546.html operation to query the available specifications of storage-layer custom ApsaraDB RDS instances, including specification codes and storage capacity ranges
parameters.help_zh:
更新后的存储层私有定制RDS实例规格码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196546.html接口查看可购买的存储层私有定制RDS实例规格，包括规格代码和存储空间范围

parameters.help_en:
The storage capacity of the storage-layer custom ApsaraDB RDS instance after the update.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196546.html operation to query the available specifications of storage-layer custom ApsaraDB RDS instances, including specification codes and storage capacity ranges

parameters.name: storage

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use vouchers to offset the purchase cost. Valid values: true and false (default).

After vouchers are used, if you need to downgrade the specifications, the amount offset by vouchers will not be refunded
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用代金券抵扣购买费用，取值为：true或false（默认值）。

使用代金券后，若需要进行降配操作，由代金券抵扣的金额将不会进行退款
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon
